authority: ACS durable linearizable transaction history, never local CURRENT

invariants.I1: Exactly one committed successor per current parent; bind dataset, digest, sequence and epoch
invariants.I2: Current, membership, consumed IDs, quota charge, COMMIT event and outbox obligation change atomically in ACS
invariants.I3: Commit requires sealed synced complete generation with protected prepared retention
invariants.I4: Revocation, policy, commit and reader admission share ACS serial order
invariants.I5: Agent input never establishes job authorization
invariants.I6: New readers require fresh ACS membership; local snapshots cannot admit old history
invariants.I7: Prepared evidence precedes commit; commit event cannot be lost independently of commit
invariants.I8: Consumed bytes equal pinned sealed verified generation
invariants.I9: ACK_READY requires durable content/commit, local reconciliation, independent COMMIT log receipt and eligible generation
invariants.I10: Unavailable authority or uncertain persistence fails closed

transitions.name: admit_job
transitions.authorized_operation: Record narrowly admitted job, not permission to commit
durable_changes: Immutable admission request digest, job and principal binding, policy and expiry
transitions.crash_restart: Admission exists wholly or not; query ID
transitions.retry: Same ID/digest returns same admission; different digest rejects

transitions.name: authorize_exact_generation
preconditions: Signer verifies delegation and admission independently
Exact manifest, parent, sequence and policy digest
durable_changes: Signer idempotency record mapping authorization ID to payload digest and signed envelope
transitions.synchronization: Durable signer record before returning envelope; no ACS publication
transitions.crash_restart: Recover same envelope or fail closed; key use audit reconciled
transitions.retry: Same authorization ID and payload only; no widening

transitions.name: seal_and_sync
preconditions: Safe dirfd paths and no writable aliases
durable_changes: Payloads, manifest, authorization and local prepared intent
transitions.synchronization: Write and fsync each file including intent; close writers; fsync stage; no-replace rename; fsync both changed parents and created ancestors; check all errors
transitions.linearization_point: No publication; local durable preparation only
transitions.crash_restart: Validate complete contents and sync evidence; incomplete/uncertain files unavailable; consult ACS before cleanup
transitions.retry: Existing identical complete generation only if exact same transaction; never overwrite

transitions.name: register_prepared
preconditions: Retention reservation with no autonomous expiry deletion
transitions.authorized_operation: Reserve prepared generation and transaction identity
transitions.synchronization: ACS durable transaction; storage retains objects until explicit abort/GC grant
transitions.crash_restart: Query transaction; never infer unregistered from timeout
transitions.retry: Identical request returns same reservation; changed request rejects

transitions.name: commit_generation
preconditions: Prepared content retained and storage registration active
transitions.authorized_operation: Atomically publish one authorized dataset generation
durable_changes: Consumed authorization and admission job IDs
COMMIT event and durable outbox obligation
transitions.synchronization: Single crash-durable linearizable ACS transaction including policy/delegation/quota rows; no external second anchor update
transitions.crash_restart: Old PREPARED or full COMMITTED only; ACS unavailable means OUTCOME_UNAVAILABLE knowledge, never guessed abort
transitions.retry: Same transaction returns same result; consumed ID cannot create another commit; competing same-parent request rejects
audit_evidence: Immutable COMMIT event binding full tuple and prepared evidence

transitions.name: reconcile_cache
durable_changes: CURRENT cache tuple and local reconciliation evidence
transitions.synchronization: Write unique temp, fsync temp, atomic rename, fsync parent; compare ACS afterward; never overwrite a locally newer verified sequence with older cache
transitions.linearization_point: No logical publication point; cache visibility only
transitions.crash_restart: Stale/missing cache is ignored and rebuilt from ACS; sync failure marks storage uncertain, withholds ACK
transitions.retry: Idempotent exact cache or verified later committed successor; reader never trusts cache alone

transitions.name: export_commit_event
transitions.trusted_actor: Evidence exporter and independent audit store
transitions.authorized_operation: Sign and append typed commit evidence
transitions.synchronization: Log durable append before delivery receipt; ACS idempotent delivery update; remote store is not an atomic part of T05
transitions.linearization_point: Independent log append; no change to publication
transitions.crash_restart: Reexport from durable outbox; duplicate delivery deduplicated; conflicting payload is incident

transitions.name: record_ack_ready
preconditions: Durable exact content and ACS commit
T06 healthy cache reconciliation for same or verified later current
T07 independent COMMIT log receipt verified
transitions.synchronization: ACS durable transaction before token issuance; ACK event export is retryable, no infinite remote-ACK recursion
transitions.linearization_point: ACK_READY record commit; does not claim client received token
transitions.crash_restart: Token recoverable from same record; prior committed fact unchanged; no ACK on uncertain persistence
transitions.retry: Return same acknowledgement identity; deny new token if current quarantine policy forbids release

transitions.name: update_policy_or_revoke
preconditions: No agent or normal signer administration
transitions.authorized_operation: Revoke/rotate delegated authority or quarantine affected membership
transitions.synchronization: Same ACS serial order as T05, T10 and T11; root recovery requires independently provisioned recovery authority
transitions.linearization_point: Authority transaction durable commit; no grandfathering of later T05
transitions.crash_restart: Old or complete new policy; no mixed epoch/delegation state
transitions.retry: Same update ID/digest; version regression or ambiguous identity rejects

transitions.name: admit_reader
durable_changes: Reader pin bound to generation, principal and session
transitions.synchronization: ACS transaction serial with commit/revoke; read only exact pinned sealed objects
transitions.crash_restart: Stale session/pin cannot silently grant new read; restart obtains fresh admission
transitions.retry: Same session/pin identity or new admission; never select arbitrary older signed generation

transitions.name: authorize_delivery_and_release
transitions.authorized_operation: Deliver verified pinned content then release pin
transitions.synchronization: Final ACS check serial with revoke; release recorded separately; no claim of atomic network delivery with revocation
transitions.linearization_point: Delivery authorization check; revocation after it cannot recall in-flight bytes
transitions.crash_restart: Reacquire permission before new delivery; retained committed data not GCed
transitions.retry: Session-bound result; do not replay old permission for a new read

transitions.name: abort_and_gc_uncommitted
transitions.trusted_actor: ACS abort coordinator and restricted GC worker
transitions.authorized_operation: Abort uncommitted transaction and reclaim only its uncommitted objects
durable_changes: Terminal abort tombstone retaining used request identity
transitions.synchronization: ACS abort serialized with T05 before deletion; sync directories after removal; never delete committed membership/data in v0.2
transitions.linearization_point: ACS ABORTED transaction; subsequent commit rejects
transitions.crash_restart: Resume exact grant; no timeout-based deletion while ACS unavailable
transitions.retry: Idempotent abort/delete; no reuse of aborted authorization ID

transitions.name: recover_or_restore
preconditions: Qualified storage or service remains quarantined
transitions.trusted_actor: Restricted recovery worker; owner recovery authority for exceptional restore
transitions.authorized_operation: Reconcile projections or restore exact committed bytes, never invent membership
durable_changes: Repaired exact local bytes/cache if authorized
RECOVERED evidence with original unknowns retained
transitions.synchronization: Same sealing/fsync protocol for restored bytes; validate against ACS committed digests; resume T06/T07/T08 idempotently
transitions.linearization_point: No new publication; any new content requires a new T01-T05 transaction
transitions.crash_restart: Query again; committed missing data remains committed but unavailable/quarantined, never ABORTED
transitions.retry: Exact transaction/generation restore only; partitions produce OUTCOME_UNAVAILABLE

normative_transition_refinements.T02_T05: Enforce every AUTHORIZATION_CONTRACT_V02.json chain_validation join, including exact principals/jobs/dataset/policy/epoch/manifest/delegation/audience and validity interval subsets
normative_transition_refinements.T03_T04_T12: Bind prepared registration and GC grant to immutable never-reused storage object incarnation and transaction; serialize deletion, durable grant retirement and path reuse; old grants cannot delete new same-digest objects
normative_transition_refinements.T07: Persist one canonical signed COMMIT envelope durably before any export; retries retransmit exact stored envelope even across key rotation; previous_event_digest hashes unsigned payload, ACK commit_event_digest hashes fixed envelope
normative_transition_refinements.T08: Independent log inclusion receipt must bind exact same fixed envelope/event ID, not a re-signed equivalent payload

retention: No GC of committed generations or required membership/evidence in v0.2; resource exhaustion denies new work
genesis: Owner-provisioned dataset/root/profile and explicit sequence-zero membership under ACS durable transaction; no implicit trust-on-first-use
conditional_proof: Atomic ACS state preserves I1/I2/I4 by induction; T03/T04 retention supplies I3; projections cannot change membership; T10/T11 establish I6/I8; T08 establishes I9 under qualified storage/ACS and isolation assumptions. This is not a mechanized or executed proof.
